spots.bio: Three waterfalls with swimming pools in Bouma National Heritage Park, the lowest a short, flat walk from the visitor centre.
spots.notes: Fee FJD 50 per person, cash only, from Taveuni Tourism Association page (2026); Lonely Planet/MileHacker quote older 25-36. Guide FJD 30 optional (24h notice) not the price. Bouma park fee is its own, not a pass; no state park pass applies in Fiji. Wikivoyage: lower fall 15 min, middle 45 min, upper another hour; over 30 m high lower fall.
unverified: fee may have changed; sources conflict historically (12-50 FJD)
lower fall walk time conflicts: 10 min (ilovetaveuni) vs 15 min (Wikivoyage); bio says 'short, flat walk'

spots.bio: Lookout peak at about 1,195 m with views to Lake Tagimoucia and the Lau Group, reached on foot or by 4WD, with good birdwatching.
spots.notes: No entry fee found in sources; hike 6 km up (3-4 h) per association, guide optional and village guide recommended. fiji.travel page https://www.fiji.travel/places-to-go/taveuni-island/places/des-voeux-peak-tagimoucia returned 403: BLOCKED, check in browser. spots.bio: Community-run no-take reef protected since 1998, visited on guided snorkelling and cultural tours arranged in advance.
spots.notes: FJD 40 Cultural Experience Tour, FJD 20 Backpackers Tour, FJD 5 off per person for groups of 4+; must be arranged in advance (tel 888-0451). Site title 'Waitabu Marine Park' verified. Wikivoyage: established 1998, 1 km fringing reef, over 7 communities.
unverified: FLAG: waitabu.org admission page lists two price sets: F$40 Cultural/F$20 Backpackers and F$100 Cultural/F$70 Snorkelling. Recorded 70-100 (newer block); confirm

spots.bio: Crater lake at about 830 m above Somosomo, reached by a long guided hike, where Fiji's national flower grows.
spots.notes: F$25 custom fee including guide per Frommers (undated, read only via search snippet). Lake height 832 m (Wikivoyage). Tagimaucia flowers Oct-Jan on the shore per association; flower only on Taveuni. About 8 h round trip per Frommers.
